bullets.text: Windows Update Experience Enhanced - **Microsoft** introduces user-friendly controls for updates, prioritizing user feedback and security.
New Experimental Channels Launched - Transition to **Microsoft's** new Experimental and Beta channels begins for Windows Insiders.
GPT-5.5 Available on Azure - **OpenAI's** latest model, GPT-5.5, is now accessible through **Microsoft Foundry** for enterprise applications.
LangChain.js Course Released - **Microsoft** offers a free course for building AI applications with JavaScript, focusing on agentic capabilities.
Windows 365 Link Celebrates One Year - **Microsoft's** cloud PC solution simplifies management and enhances security for organizations.
AI-Powered Cyber Defense Strategies - **Microsoft** emphasizes the need for AI in cybersecurity to counter evolving threats.
Azure Accelerate for Databases Introduced - **Microsoft** helps organizations modernize databases for AI readiness with new offerings.
Agentic R&D Advancements - **Microsoft Discovery** expands access to agentic AI capabilities for research and development teams.
Secure Passkey Sync in Edge - **Microsoft Password Manager** enhances security with passkey syncing across devices.
